Auth.title: Auth
Auth.description: The first frame on a new socket, within five seconds: the access token.

installation_id.description: The app install's id, the one the device was registered under; lets this socket be signed out on its own when the device is removed.

AuthFrame.title: AuthFrame
AuthFrame.description: Frame `auth` an app sends to goway-realtime.

BookingAmountClaimed.title: BookingAmountClaimed
BookingAmountClaimed.description: One side of a delivered haul says it settled at another sum; nothing changes until an operator decides.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

amount.description: The claimed sum, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

recorded_amount.description: The sum on record now, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

BookingAmountSettled.title: BookingAmountSettled
BookingAmountSettled.description: An operator accepted an amount claim; the haul now settles at `settled_amount` and billing adjusts its commission.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

shipper_org_id.description: Null only when the load could not be read.

previous_amount.description: The sum on record before, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

settled_amount.description: The sum the operator settled on, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

BookingCancelled.title: BookingCancelled
BookingCancelled.description: A booking ended before the cargo was loaded. The load goes back to the board. Two paths send the same fields: either side cancelling (`by` is `shipper` or `carrier`) and an operator (`by` is `operator`).

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

reason.description: What the canceller wrote; empty when nothing was written.

driver_user_id.description: Null when no driver was assigned.

BookingCancelledFrame.title: BookingCancelledFrame
BookingCancelledFrame.description: Frame `booking_cancelled` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the driver and to the booking's viewers. It currently forwards the internal `booking.cancelled` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

BookingCompleted.title: BookingCompleted
BookingCompleted.description: A delivered haul was closed: by the shipper, by an operator, or by the auto-complete sweep. All three send the same fields. Billing charges its commission from this event.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

agreed_amount.description: Price agreed at booking, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

settled_amount.description: What the haul actually settled at: the agreed price unless another sum was confirmed, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

completed_at.description: When the haul was closed; the code allows null, it is always set. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

charges.description: Price lines; the first is always the agreed tariff.

waiting_minutes.description: Billable minutes the driver waited at pickup.

waiting_amount.description: What the waiting costs, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

waiting_billable.description: Whether the waiting is charged to the shipper.

total_amount.description: Charges plus waiting, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); the code allows null.

BookingCompletedFrame.title: BookingCompletedFrame
BookingCompletedFrame.description: Frame `booking_completed` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the driver and to the booking's viewers. It currently forwards the internal `booking.completed` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

BookingCreated.title: BookingCreated
BookingCreated.description: A load was booked. Two paths: an accepted offer, or an instant claim from dispatch, which adds `source: instant`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

driver_user_id.description: The driver; the offer path allows null, a booking always has one.

agreed_amount.description: Agreed price, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

BookingCreatedFrame.title: BookingCreatedFrame
BookingCreatedFrame.description: Frame `booking_created` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the booked driver. It currently forwards the internal `booking.created` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

BookingEtaFrame.title: BookingEtaFrame
BookingEtaFrame.description: Frame `booking_eta` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the booking's viewers only, and dropped when a socket is slow. It currently forwards the internal `booking.eta_updated` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

BookingEtaUpdated.title: BookingEtaUpdated
BookingEtaUpdated.description: The arrival window or the time the truck is free again moved: when the haul is booked (`confirmed`), at every carrier step, and on fresh GPS while `en_route` or `in_transit`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

eta_stop.description: Which stop the window is for; null when no arrival is expected any more.

eta_from.description: Earliest expected arrival at `eta_stop`; null with it. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

eta_to.description: Latest expected arrival at `eta_stop`; null with it. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

free_at.description: When the truck is expected to be empty again. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

free_region_id.description: Where the truck will be free: the drop-off region; null when unknown.

truck_class.description: The booked vehicle's truck class code.

BookingReturnLoads.title: BookingReturnLoads
BookingReturnLoads.description: Hours before a truck is empty: loads are waiting in the region where it unloads. Sent once per haul.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

region_id.description: The drop-off region, where the truck will be free.

heads_home.description: How many of them go back to the haul's pickup region.

free_at.description: When the truck is expected to be empty. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

BookingSource.title: BookingSource
BookingSource.description: Present only for an instant claim from dispatch; an accepted offer leaves it out.

BookingStatusChanged.title: BookingStatusChanged
BookingStatusChanged.description: The carrier moved the haul one step on: `en_route`, `at_pickup`, `loading`, `in_transit` or `delivered`. Completion and cancellation have their own subjects.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

BookingStatusFrame.title: BookingStatusFrame
BookingStatusFrame.description: Frame `booking_status` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the driver and to the booking's viewers. It currently forwards the internal `booking.status_changed` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

CarrierDocumentExpired.title: CarrierDocumentExpired
CarrierDocumentExpired.description: A carrier's document passed its expiry date; the hourly sweep marked it expired.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

expired_at.description: The document's expiry date. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

CarrierDocumentExpiring.title: CarrierDocumentExpiring
CarrierDocumentExpiring.description: A carrier's document expires within the warning window; sent once per document.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

expires_at.description: The document's expiry date. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

CarrierDocumentReviewed.title: CarrierDocumentReviewed
CarrierDocumentReviewed.description: An operator approved or rejected a carrier's document.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

note.description: What the operator wrote; a rejection always has one.

CarrierDocumentUpdated.title: CarrierDocumentUpdated
CarrierDocumentUpdated.description: A carrier submitted a new version of a document; it waits for review.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

version.description: Version of this document kind, from 1.

CarrierLineChanged.title: CarrierLineChanged
CarrierLineChanged.description: A driver opened or changed their line, its return direction or its truck.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

bidirectional.description: The way back is taken too.

vehicle_id.description: The truck for the line; null after it was removed.

CarrierVerificationChanged.title: CarrierVerificationChanged
CarrierVerificationChanged.description: A carrier organization's verification moved: submitted or reopened by a replaced document (`pending`), or decided by an operator.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

user_ids.description: The organization's members, so a consumer can act on each without its own member list.

ChargeLine.title: ChargeLine
ChargeLine.description: One priced line of the haul.

amount.description: Line total, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

ClientFrame.title: ClientFrame
ClientFrame.description: Any frame an app may send; `type` tells which.

CompletedBy.title: CompletedBy
CompletedBy.description: Who closed the haul; `system` is the auto-complete sweep.

Connected.title: Connected
Connected.description: The `auth` frame was accepted; the socket is live.

worker.description: The goway-realtime worker holding the socket, `<host>-<pid>-<suffix>`; for logs.

ConnectedFrame.title: ConnectedFrame
ConnectedFrame.description: Frame `connected` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

ConnectionConfig.title: ConnectionConfig
ConnectionConfig.description: Current realtime settings the app plays by.

offer_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a driver has to answer an offer.

offer_grace_seconds.description: Extra seconds after the deadline a late answer is still honoured.

line_changes_per_day.description: Line changes a driver may make per Tashkent day.

DevicePushFailed.title: DevicePushFailed
DevicePushFailed.description: The push provider rejected a device's token as dead; the device should be shown as unreachable.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

DeviceRemoved.title: DeviceRemoved
DeviceRemoved.description: The owner removed a device; its sessions are closed and it is pushed no more.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

DeviceUpserted.title: DeviceUpserted
DeviceUpserted.description: A device was registered or came back after removal, or its push token changed or was cleared (signing out clears it).

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

push_token.description: FCM registration token; null when the device can no longer be pushed.

DispatchOffered.title: DispatchOffered
DispatchOffered.description: An instant load was offered to a wave of drivers on its line, so a driver whose app is in the background still sees it. Loss-tolerant: the socket frame is the offer itself.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, a random UUID stamped by goway-lib-rs when it publishes. Consumers dedupe on it.

truck_class.description: Truck class code from the reference list.

amount.description: The load's fixed price, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

deadline_at.description: Answer deadline, unix milliseconds in server time.

DisplayCurrency.title: DisplayCurrency
DisplayCurrency.description: Display currency; charges stay in UZS.

DriverLocation.title: DriverLocation
DriverLocation.description: The booked driver's live position, relayed to the booking's viewers as it arrives; dropped when a socket is slow.

heading.description: Degrees from north; null when the driver's device did not send it.

speed.description: Null when the driver's device did not send it.

DriverLocationFrame.title: DriverLocationFrame
DriverLocationFrame.description: Frame `driver_location` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

DriverOffline.title: DriverOffline
DriverOffline.description: A driver left the line: went offline, the line expired, the grace after a disconnect ran out, or the sessions were revoked.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, a random UUID stamped by goway-lib-rs when it publishes. Consumers dedupe on it.

org_id.description: From the presence record, which always has it.

DriverOnline.title: DriverOnline
DriverOnline.description: A driver opened or changed a line and waits for instant offers.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, a random UUID stamped by goway-lib-rs when it publishes. Consumers dedupe on it.

bidirectional.description: Also takes loads on the way back.

expires_at.description: When the line ends, unix milliseconds.

DriverStatsChanged.title: DriverStatsChanged
DriverStatsChanged.description: A driver's completed-haul count or rating changed. Counters only grow, so a late older event is recognisable.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

ErrorFrame.title: ErrorFrame
ErrorFrame.description: Frame `error` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

FrameError.title: FrameError
FrameError.description: A frame was refused; the same problem shape as REST errors. Two forms are sent: a first frame that is not `auth`, an unreadable frame and a refused booking subscription send only `code` and `key`; every other refusal sends the full problem body with `type`, `title`, `status` and `code`, plus `detail`, `key` and `params` when set.

code.description: Stable code the app branches on.

GoOffline.title: GoOffline
GoOffline.description: Leave the line. Nothing to send: an empty object, or no `data` at all.

GoOfflineFrame.title: GoOfflineFrame
GoOfflineFrame.description: Frame `go_offline` an app sends to goway-realtime.

GoOnline.title: GoOnline
GoOnline.description: Start receiving instant offers on the line saved with `PUT /v1/carrier/line`, with its vehicle.

GoOnlineFrame.title: GoOnlineFrame
GoOnlineFrame.description: Frame `go_online` an app sends to goway-realtime.

Kicked.title: Kicked
Kicked.description: This socket is being closed by the server; sign in again.

reason.description: `device_removed`, `logout` (closed from another device), the `user.session_revoked` reason, or what a service passed to `/internal/kick`; null when none was given.

KickedFrame.title: KickedFrame
KickedFrame.description: Frame `kicked` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

LoadCancelled.title: LoadCancelled
LoadCancelled.description: The shipper withdrew an open load.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

LoadExpired.title: LoadExpired
LoadExpired.description: An open load passed its expiry unbooked; the sweep closed it.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

LoadPosted.title: LoadPosted
LoadPosted.description: A load is open on the board: just posted (one event per truck of a multi-truck post), or back on the board after its booking was cancelled, which adds `reposted: true`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

from_region_id.description: Pickup region; null when the address resolved to none.

to_region_id.description: Drop-off region; null when the address resolved to none.

truck_class.description: Truck class code from the reference list.

allow_instant.description: Whether instant dispatch may offer the load.

asking_amount.description: The shipper's price, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); null when it asks for offers.

bonus_amount.description: Shipper bonus set aside for this truck, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); null when none.

suggested_amount.description: Market price GoWay suggested, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); null when there was none.

pickup_from.description: Earliest pickup; null when not given. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

pickup_to.description: Latest pickup, also the posting's expiry; null when not given. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

pickup_lat.description: Pickup point latitude; null only when the load has no stops.

pickup_lng.description: Pickup point longitude; null only when the load has no stops.

group_id.description: Shared by the sibling loads of one multi-truck post; null for a single truck.

reposted.description: Present, and true, only when a cancelled booking put the load back.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: The driver's position. Relayed to booking viewers and sampled as evidence only while a booking is active.

heading.description: Degrees from north, when the device knows it.

speed.description: Speed the device reports, when it knows it.

LocationFrame.title: LocationFrame
LocationFrame.description: Frame `location` an app sends to goway-realtime.

LocationSampled.title: LocationSampled
LocationSampled.description: A driver's GPS position during an active booking, sampled every `location_sample_seconds` as evidence of the haul.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, a random UUID stamped by goway-lib-rs when it publishes. Consumers dedupe on it.

recorded_at.description: When the position was sampled, RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Something landed in the user's notification feed; refresh the badge. Copied from `notification.created`; a field that event lacked or sent empty arrives as null.

NotificationCreated.title: NotificationCreated
NotificationCreated.description: A message landed in a user's notification feed: from an event, or from an admin announcement (`kind: announcement`).

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

NotificationFrame.title: NotificationFrame
NotificationFrame.description: Frame `notification` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

NotificationPrefs.title: NotificationPrefs
NotificationPrefs.description: Every switch, sent whole whenever one of them changed.

offers.description: Push for new offers and dispatch results.

OfferAccepted.title: OfferAccepted
OfferAccepted.description: An offer was accepted and became a booking; published together with `booking.created`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

driver_user_id.description: The driver who made the offer; the code allows null, an offer always has one.

OfferCreated.title: OfferCreated
OfferCreated.description: A carrier asked for a load, or either side countered the other's price.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

amount.description: Offered price, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

OfferKind.title: OfferKind
OfferKind.description: Who made the offer and how.

OfferProposed.title: OfferProposed
OfferProposed.description: An instant load offered to this driver; answer before `deadline_at`.

deadline_at.description: Answer deadline, unix milliseconds in server time.

OfferProposedFrame.title: OfferProposedFrame
OfferProposedFrame.description: Frame `offer_proposed` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

OfferResponse.title: OfferResponse
OfferResponse.description: The driver's answer to an instant offer.

OfferResponseFrame.title: OfferResponseFrame
OfferResponseFrame.description: Frame `offer_response` an app sends to goway-realtime.

OfferResult.title: OfferResult
OfferResult.description: How an offer ended for this driver.

booking_id.description: Sent only when the outcome is `won`; null when goway-loads' answer could not be read.

OfferResultFrame.title: OfferResultFrame
OfferResultFrame.description: Frame `offer_result` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

OffersBlocked.title: OffersBlocked
OffersBlocked.description: The wallet stopped being eligible; no offers until it is settled.

OffersBlockedFrame.title: OffersBlockedFrame
OffersBlockedFrame.description: Frame `offers_blocked` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

OffersUnblocked.title: OffersUnblocked
OffersUnblocked.description: The wallet is eligible again after being blocked; nothing in it.

OffersUnblockedFrame.title: OffersUnblockedFrame
OffersUnblockedFrame.description: Frame `offers_unblocked` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

Offline.title: Offline
Offline.description: The driver left the line: after `go_offline`, or taken off it with a `reason`.

OfflineFrame.title: OfflineFrame
OfflineFrame.description: Frame `offline` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

OfflineReason.title: OfflineReason
OfflineReason.description: Why the server took the driver off the line; absent when the driver left by themselves.

Online.title: Online
Online.description: The driver is on their line: after `go_online`, and again whenever the line is changed while online.

bidirectional.description: The way back is taken too.

vehicle_id.description: The truck the offers are matched against.

queue_position.description: Place in the outbound line's queue, from 1.

offers_blocked.description: Set when the wallet blocks offers, with the reason; null otherwise.

OnlineFrame.title: OnlineFrame
OnlineFrame.description: Frame `online` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

OrgUpdated.title: OrgUpdated
OrgUpdated.description: An organization's details changed. Only what changed is sent, besides `org_id` and `updated_at`: a role switch sends `kind` and `account_type`; the organization screen any of `name`, `legal_name`, `inn`, `contact_phone`, `address`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

updated_at.description: When the change was made. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

Ping.title: Ping
Ping.description: Nothing: an empty object, or no `data` at all.

PingFrame.title: PingFrame
PingFrame.description: Frame `ping` an app sends to goway-realtime.

Pong.title: Pong
Pong.description: The answer to `ping`; nothing in it.

PongFrame.title: PongFrame
PongFrame.description: Frame `pong` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

RatingCreated.title: RatingCreated
RatingCreated.description: The shipper rated a completed haul; sent once per haul.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

driver_user_id.description: The rated driver; the code allows null, a booking always has one.

RatingTarget.title: RatingTarget
RatingTarget.description: Who was rated; only the driver today.

RegionChanged.title: RegionChanged
RegionChanged.description: An admin opened or closed a region for the marketplace.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

ServerFrame.title: ServerFrame
ServerFrame.description: Any frame goway-realtime may send; `type` tells which.

SessionRevokedReason.title: SessionRevokedReason
SessionRevokedReason.description: Why every session of the user was closed. An operator's own note on a block stays with staff.

SessionStarted.title: SessionStarted
SessionStarted.description: Somebody signed in to this account; ignore it when `installation_id` is this app's own. Copied from `user.login`; a field that event lacked or sent empty arrives as null.

at.description: When the sign-in happened, as `user.login` wrote it.

SessionStartedFrame.title: SessionStartedFrame
SessionStartedFrame.description: Frame `session_started` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

SessionsClosedReason.title: SessionsClosedReason
SessionsClosedReason.description: Why the sessions were closed; only a sign-out from another device today.

SettingsChanged.title: SettingsChanged
SettingsChanged.description: An admin changed or reset runtime settings of one service. Published by goway-lib for goway-auth, goway-loads, goway-billing and goway-notify, and by goway-realtime itself, with the same fields.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event: the outbox row id from a Python service, a random UUID from goway-realtime. Consumers dedupe on it.

service.description: The service whose settings changed, for example `goway-loads`.

by.description: The admin who changed them; null when not known.

SubmittedDocumentStatus.title: SubmittedDocumentStatus
SubmittedDocumentStatus.description: A new version always waits for review.

SubscribeBooking.title: SubscribeBooking
SubscribeBooking.description: Watch a booking of the caller's organization: status, arrival window and the driver's position.

SubscribeBookingFrame.title: SubscribeBookingFrame
SubscribeBookingFrame.description: Frame `subscribe_booking` an app sends to goway-realtime.

SubscribedFrame.title: SubscribedFrame
SubscribedFrame.description: Frame `subscribed` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

SupportTicketCreated.title: SupportTicketCreated
SupportTicketCreated.description: A user opened a support ticket.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

number.description: Reference the user sees: `T-` and six characters, for example `T-7KQ2MZ`.

order_id.description: The haul the ticket is about; null when none was named.

SupportTicketReplied.title: SupportTicketReplied
SupportTicketReplied.description: Support answered or closed a ticket.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

number.description: Reference the user sees: `T-` and six characters, for example `T-7KQ2MZ`.

TicketReplyStatus.title: TicketReplyStatus
TicketReplyStatus.description: The ticket's status after the reply.

UnsubscribeBookingFrame.title: UnsubscribeBookingFrame
UnsubscribeBookingFrame.description: Frame `unsubscribe_booking` an app sends to goway-realtime.

UserBlocked.title: UserBlocked
UserBlocked.description: An operator blocked the account; the app shows the reason on its blocked screen.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

reason.description: What the operator told the user, in their words.

UserCreated.title: UserCreated
UserCreated.description: An account came into being. Three paths publish it with different fields: self-signup sends `account_type`; an admin create sends `first_name` and `last_name`, either of which may be null; an admin restore of a soft-deleted account sends `updated_at`. `user_id`, `org_id`, `role`, `phone` and `language` are always sent.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

role.description: Role name. Self-signup sends `shipper` or `carrier`, an admin create the role it picked, a restore the stored role or an empty string when the user has none.

phone.description: E.164 number, `+998…`. A restore sends the stored value, which is `del:…` for an account its owner deleted.

language.description: App language code: uz, uzc, ru, en, kaa or zh.

first_name.description: Admin create only; null when the admin gave none.

last_name.description: Admin create only; null when the admin gave none.

updated_at.description: Admin restore only: when the account came back. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

UserDeleted.title: UserDeleted
UserDeleted.description: An account was deleted: by its owner, without `updated_at`, or by an admin, soft or hard, with `updated_at`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

updated_at.description: Admin deletes only: when the account was deleted. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

UserLogin.title: UserLogin
UserLogin.description: Somebody signed in to the account: by code, password, password reset or phone change. The device fields are null when the app sent no device.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

device_id.description: Device row the session belongs to.

model.description: Device model as the app reported it.

new_device.description: True the first time this install signs in, or when a removed device comes back.

at.description: When the sign-in happened. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

UserSessionRevoked.title: UserSessionRevoked
UserSessionRevoked.description: Every session of the account was closed; each app must sign in again.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

UserSessionsClosed.title: UserSessionsClosed
UserSessionsClosed.description: Some of the account's sessions were closed from another device; those installs must sign in again.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

installation_ids.description: Installs whose sessions were closed; never empty.

UserUnblocked.title: UserUnblocked
UserUnblocked.description: An operator lifted the block; the user may sign in again.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

UserUpdated.title: UserUpdated
UserUpdated.description: Something about an account changed. Only what changed is sent, besides `user_id` and `updated_at`, and five paths send five field sets: a confirmed phone change sends `phone`; the account settings screen any of `language`, `currency`, `theme`, `notification_prefs`; a role switch `role`; an admin edit any of `phone`, `language`, `first_name`, `last_name`, plus `role` whenever the admin named one; a profile edit `first_name`, `last_name`, `email` and `avatar_url` together, each of them possibly null.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

language.description: App language code: uz, uzc, ru, en, kaa or zh.

role.description: Role name: `shipper` or `carrier` from a role switch, any role from an admin edit.

first_name.description: Null only from a profile edit, when the profile has no first name.

last_name.description: Null only from a profile edit, when the profile has no last name.

email.description: Profile edit only; null when the profile has no email.

avatar_url.description: Profile edit only. Public avatar address; null when there is none or it would expire.

updated_at.description: When the change was made. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

VehicleUpserted.title: VehicleUpserted
VehicleUpserted.description: A fleet vehicle was added or changed; the whole vehicle is sent every time.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

plate_number.description: Normalized plate: no spaces, upper case.

truck_class.description: Truck class code from the reference list.

capabilities.description: Capability codes: rear_ramp, open_top, side_curtain, tail_lift, refrigerated.

capacity_kg.description: Payload in kilograms; null when not given.

brand.description: Make, as the driver entered it.

model.description: Model, as the driver entered it.

color.description: Body colour code; apps name it in their language.

updated_at.description: When the vehicle was saved. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

VerificationChanged.title: VerificationChanged
VerificationChanged.description: The carrier's verification moved; the app re-reads `GET /v1/carrier/verification` for the note.

VerificationChangedFrame.title: VerificationChangedFrame
VerificationChangedFrame.description: Frame `verification_changed` goway-realtime sends to an app.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

VerificationStatus.title: VerificationStatus
VerificationStatus.description: The new verification status; `expired` when an approved document ran out.

WalletEligibilityChanged.title: WalletEligibilityChanged
WalletEligibilityChanged.description: An organization's wallet started or stopped being allowed to receive offers. One event per user of the organization, or a single event with a null `user_id` when billing knows no user of it yet.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

user_id.description: Null when billing's replica holds no user of the organization.

balance.description: Wallet balance in so'm; negative means debt.

debt_limit.description: How far below zero the balance may go, so'm.

reason.description: Why offers stopped; null when the wallet is eligible.

WalletEntryPosted.title: WalletEntryPosted
WalletEntryPosted.description: A line was written to an organization's wallet ledger.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

amount.description: Signed change of the balance, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

balance.description: Balance after the line, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); negative means debt.

booking_id.description: The haul the line is for; null for lines not tied to a haul.

WalletToppedUp.title: WalletToppedUp
WalletToppedUp.description: An operator took cash for an organization's wallet and issued a receipt.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

amount.description: Cash received, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

balance.description: Balance after the top-up, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); negative means debt.
